name: Hikami Yuria
source:
Chiharu's cousin. She is the one who turned Espoir into a swimsuit maid cafe. She is a competitive and stubborn woman who loves to do flashy things to attract attention.

She helps Chiharu, who has run away from her husband and is in debt, by providing her with funds.

She is a troublemaker who loves to tease other people, and she does whatever she pleases to make Kazunori feel uncomfortable.

[From [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=734946]Getchu[/url]]
